---
title: "Public-sector wage policy"
subtitle: "Stated wage policy decisions across states and territories"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
library(crosstalk)
tar_source("R")

wage_rows <- tryCatch(tar_read(wage_panel), error = function(e) tibble::tibble())
```

::: {.callout-note}
Phase 5 deliverable. Per-jurisdiction CSVs under
`data/extracted/wage_policy/` populate this table; new wage-policy
decisions land here on the next pipeline rebuild. The seed rows
shown are PLACEHOLDERs --- replace with real extracted values.
:::

```{r}
if (nrow(wage_rows) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No wage policy rows in the warehouse yet.")
} else {
  shared <- SharedData$new(wage_rows)

  bscols(
    widths = c(3, 9),
    list(
      filter_select("jur", "Jurisdiction", shared, ~jurisdiction),
      filter_slider("pct", "Annual rise (%)", shared, ~annual_rise_pct,
                    step = 0.25, round = TRUE)
    ),
    plot_ly(shared,
            x = ~effective_from, y = ~annual_rise_pct,
            color = ~jurisdiction,
            type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
            text = ~paste0("<b>", document_id, "</b><br>",
                           "Coverage: ", coverage, "<br>",
                           policy_text),
            hoverinfo = "text",
            marker = list(size = 11)) |>
      sbm_theme_fiscal(
        title       = "Stated annual rise (per cent)",
        yaxis_title = "Per cent"
      )
  )
}
```

## Decisions

```{r}
if (nrow(wage_rows) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No wage policy rows.")
} else {
  wage_rows |>
    select(jurisdiction, document_id, effective_from, effective_to,
           annual_rise_pct, coverage, productivity_offset,
           sign_on_bonus, policy_text) |>
    reactable(
      defaultPageSize = 15,
      searchable      = TRUE,
      filterable      = TRUE,
      striped         = TRUE
    )
}
```
